question: Shakoor Khan and Pt. Ram Narayan are associated with which musical instrument?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarangi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sarangi:-

 
 
• It is a bowed string instrument that is a staple of Indian classical music.
 
• It is a long, hollow wooden body with a skin covering. It has three strings, which are attached to a bow.
 
• The bow is played with a bow.
 
• Shakoor Khan and Pandit Ram Narayan were both renowned musicians who played the sarangi, a stringed instrument that is popular in Indian classical music.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Shehnai:-

 
 
• It​ is a wind instrument that is commonly played in North Indian weddings and other auspicious occasions.
 
 
 
• Guitar:-
 
 
• It is a western instrument that is not typically associated with Indian classical music.
 
 
 
• Veena:-
 
 
• It is a plucked stringed instrument that is popular in South Indian classical music.
